summary: Iteration 1 cold codegen: 19 Java files, two controllers (GasAnalysisController, MovementController). Every requirement is traced. The issues below are design choices and invented defaults for human review; no requirement is unimplemented.

issues.title: Terminal behaviour modelled as ordinary states, not RoboChart final states
issues.raw: CD-GA-Beh6 says gas analysis 'concludes its search, processing no further readings'; CD-MV-Beh9 says Movement 'stays halted' in Found. The codegen rules require every mode to have an outgoing transition.
issues.fix_directive: Gas analysis enters mode Concluded, whose only transition is a gas-triggered self-loop that just retains the reading in gs (CD-GA-Var1) without analysing it. Found's only transition is an obstacle-triggered self-loop that records l (CD-MV-Var4) and issues no motion. Confirm this reading of 'concludes' / 'stays halted'.

issues.title: Analysis guards written as sts == noGas and its negation
issues.raw: CD-GA-FR3: both transitions leaving Analysis are guarded by sts.
issues.fix_directive: The gasD branch is guarded by !(sts == noGas), which is equivalent to sts == gasD because Status has exactly two values (CD-DM1).

issues.title: Chem representation and what counts as 'indicating the target chemical'
issues.raw: CD-DM4 leaves Chem opaque; CD-Fn1 does not define when a reading indicates the target.
issues.fix_directive: Chem is an enum {TARGET, OTHER}. analysis returns gasD iff some entry has c == TARGET and i > 0.

issues.title: angle(x): sensor position to direction mapping
issues.raw: CD-Fn3/CD-DM7 reference angle(x) but never define it.
issues.fix_directive: Position 1->Front, 2->Right, 3->Back, 4->Left, repeating every four positions. Ties resolve to the lowest position. An empty reading yields Front.

issues.title: intensity/location range over every entry regardless of chemical
issues.raw: CD-Fn2/CD-Fn3 take the maximum across the whole sequence, so a strong non-target chemical could steer the robot or trigger 'found'.
issues.fix_directive: Implemented literally, over all entries. Restricting the functions to target-chemical entries would need a spec change.

issues.title: Constant values and initial variable values
issues.raw: CD-Const1..6 give no values; no initial values are given for a, l, anl, sts, ins, d0, d1, T.
issues.fix_directive: THR=2.0, LV=1.0, EVADE_TIME=1, STUCK_PERIOD=2, STUCK_DIST=1.0, OUT_PERIOD=1 (in clock units). Initial values: a=Front, anl=Front, l=front, sts=noGas, ins=0, d0=d1=0, T=0.

issues.title: Odometer sampled as a sensor query; changeDirection placed on Vehicle
issues.raw: CD-Evt3 is typed 'event' but describes sampling. CD-OP4 does not say which component provides changeDirection.
issues.fix_directive: d0 and d1 are assigned from OdometerSensor.odometer(). Vehicle.changeDirection(l) is layered on move(lv, ...).

issues.title: Obstacle events outside Going/TryingAgain/Found
issues.raw: CD-MV-Var4 says l is updated on each obstacle event, but no transition accepts obstacle in Waiting, Avoiding, AvoidingAgain or GettingOut.
issues.fix_directive: Followed the transition list: obstacle is not accepted in those states, so l is not updated there.

issues.title: During action and autonomous cycles
issues.raw: CD-MV-FR1: Waiting's during action is randomWalk().
issues.fix_directive: randomWalk() is the first statement of the Waiting block, so it runs on every cycle spent in Waiting. Autonomous transitions fire on step(null). ChemicalDetector settles both controllers and forwards turn/stop/resume from gas analysis to movement (CD-ARCH2).

next_step: Run the pipeline via scripts/run_claude_iteration.sh and act on the first failing phase.
